gaps.sentence: He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
The economy showed further ___ (WEAK) in the third quarter.
gaps.explanation: 'Further weakness' — the noun form follows the adjective 'further'.

gaps.sentence: The document is of great ___ (IMPORTANT) to the case.
The factory has doubled its ___ (PRODUCE) of electric batteries.
gaps.explanation: 'Its production' — the noun for the amount manufactured follows the possessive.
